name: Inchworm Walkout
steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Hinge at your hips and bend forward, placing your hands flat on the floor in front of your feet (soften knees if needed).
Walk your hands forward one at a time across the floor until your body reaches a full, straight high plank position.
Pause in the high plank for one full second with your core tightly engaged.
Walk your hands backward toward your feet, keeping your legs as straight as comfortable, and return to a standing position.
coaching_cues: Maintain steady core tension in the plank; do not allow your lower back or hips to sag.
Keep your hands under your shoulders as you walk forward.
